column1: # Species in HYDRA-Win's clinical Mash sketch (db/sketch/species/clinical_species.msh).
# Kleborate's sketch, which upstream Hydra uses, covers the Enterobacterales only.
# Without a sketch, every other genome is named from its MLST scheme, and that is
# not enough for the species below: several share one scheme with their
# neighbours (N. meningitidis, N. gonorrhoeae and N. lactamica are all typed by
# PubMLST's "neisseria" scheme; S. pneumoniae's scheme types S. pseudopneumoniae;
# the A. baumannii schemes type A. pittii and A. nosocomialis), and a species
# call decides which AMRFinderPlus mutation catalogue and which organism typing
# Built by tools/build_species_sketch.py from NCBI RefSeq (public domain). Only
# genomes that pass NCBI's ANI taxonomy check are used.
# Deliberately NOT included, because a Mash distance cannot separate them from
# a neighbour and a confident wrong name is worse than none:
#   Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex  (M. bovis, intrinsically pyrazinamide-
#                                        resistant, is within d < 0.01 of M. tuberculosis)
#   Bacillus cereus group                (B. anthracis sits inside B. cereus s.l.)
#   Burkholderia mallei                  (a clonal lineage inside B. pseudomallei)
#   Shigella                             (inside E. coli; ShigEiFinder separates them)
# Columns: species (NCBI name), group, why it is here.
